entity_geography.text: A 2026 02 OP - Development and maintenance of learning products for the EU Agency for Railways Annex 3: Standard forms The standard forms are to be completed and provided as part of your offer. Identification of the tenderer : Business Partner Form The tenderer (or the single point of contact in case of joint tender) must provide a Business Partner Form and supporting documents. Article V – Caractéristiques principales 1) Quantités Dans un contexte de changement et de mutation des collectivités territoriales, la Région innove en matière de développement des compétences des encadrants. Elle se modernise dans son fonctionnement et est particulièrement impliquée dans la transformation de l’administration depuis plusieurs années. Ces évolutions successives exigent de ses managers, une adaptation constante de leur organisation et méthodes de travail. Près de 300 managers opérationnels au siège et 800 managers de proximité dans les établissements scolaires sont ainsi sollicités pour animer les équipes. La Région Ile-de- France s’est dotée d’une structure spécifique d’accompagnement des managers, le Campus des cadres et d’une charte managériale. Le présent accord-cadre a pour objet la mise en place des modules de formation liés au développement managérial à destination des managers . Il est décomposé en 2 lots suivants : - Lot 1 : « Formations au management pour les managers de proximité dans les lycées » - Lot 2 : « Dispositif d’accompagnement à la prise de poste de responsabilité à la Région Île-de-France » 2) Reconduction : oui Nombre de reconductions éventuelles ou fourchette : 2 Le présent marché est passé pour

This panel competition is for the provision of Entrepreneurship Training Services to support the ARC Hub for ICT, TU Dublin. The panel will be used to appoint suitably qualified service providers to deliver structured entrepreneurship training to publicly funded ICT translational research teams. Overview of Requirements 2.1 About the ARC Hub for ICT The ARC Hub for ICT has been established to create a thriving entrepreneurial pathway for Irish ICT research, with a vision of connecting academic research outputs to innovation, entrepreneurship, and commercialisation. Led by TU Dublin, Ireland’s largest technological university, the Hub is positioned as a national resource to help researchers transform their work into impactful solutions. The position of the Hub within the Irish publicly funded ICT research ecosystem is to play a bridging role between ICT research supported by Research Ireland Research Centres (RCs) and Centres for Research Training (CRTs) and the next stage of entrepreneurial or commercial activity. This is particularly timely, as a large number of PhD graduates are now emerging from these programmes, generating a surge in ICT re

ovation, entrepreneurship, and commercialisation. Led by TU Dublin, Ireland’s largest technological university, the Hub is positioned as a national resource to help researchers transform their work into impactful solutions. The position of the Hub within the Irish publicly funded ICT research ecosystem is to play a bridging role between ICT research supported by Research Ireland Research Centres (RCs) and Centres for Research Training (CRTs) and the next stage of entrepreneurial or commercial activity. This is particularly timely, as a large number of PhD graduates are now emerging from these programmes, generating a surge in ICT research outputs ready for translation. insurance_bonds.text: EMENT OF OBJECTIVES (SOO) For Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) Topic Area 3 1.0 Purpose The objective of this effort is to address cyber threats to national critical space missions (e.g., Position, Navigation, and Timing (PNT), Missile Warning/Missile Tracking (MW/MT), Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM)) through the research, design, development, testing, and demonstration of a comprehensive Secure by-Design Space Vehicle (SDSV) system. 2.0 Background Space vehicles are increasingly recognized as vulnerable platforms facing sophisticated cyber threats. To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. This project aims to reduce the attack surfaces of space vehicles and implement robust resiliency mechanisms that enable self-protection and rapid recovery from cyber anomalies, leveraging Cyber-Hardened Satellite Software (CHSS) technology. 3.0 Period and Place of Performance • Period of Performance: The anticipated period of performance is a 12-month Base effort, followed by three (3) 12-month Option periods, plus 3 months for final reporting (Total 51 Months). • Place of Performance: The work will be performed primarily at the contractors facilit

To ensure mission assurance, there is a critical need to provide advanced defensive solutions for space assets. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. entity_geography.text: ealthcare Training Services Contract or concession notice – standard regime 1 Buyer 1.1 Buyer Official name: Leading Healthcare Providers Skillnet Legal type of the buyer: Body governed by public law, controlled by a central government authority Activity of the contracting authority: Education 2 Procedure 2.1 Procedure Title: 2026 ­ 2028 Dynamic Purchasing System for Healthcare Training Services Description: LHP Skillnet is establishing a Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) to facilitate the provision of services for the period 2026 to 2028. The DPS will provide an ongoing mechanism that allows suitably qualified suppliers who meet the minimum eligibility and quality thresholds to apply for admission at any time during the life of the system. Unlike a traditional framework agreement, the DPS is fully electronic and remains open throughout its duration. Once admitted to the DPS, suppliers may be invited to participate in mini competitions for specific training requirements as they arise. Contracts will be awarded following these mini competitions in accordance with the applicable procurement rules. The DPS will operate in line with the provisions of the relevant procurement directives and will remain in place for a period of three years. Suppliers may join or leave the DPS at any stage du

Context The Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH is a service provider in the field of international cooperation for sustainable development and international education work, with worldwide operations on behalf of the German Government and other commissioning parties. GIZ supports change processes in developing countries and emerging economies by providing tailor -made, cost -efficient, and effective services for sustainable development. The Ge

l organizations, national governments, civil society, and the private sector to address global challenges and achieve the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Within the Caribbean, BMZ has prioritized climate resilience, environmental sustainability, and inclusive economic transformation, channeling these commitments into regional programming supported by GIZ. The Caribbean region faces persistent and interrelated problems that demand urgent attention and evidence -based solutions. Climate change impacts —including more intense hurricanes, sea -level rise, saltwater intrusion, and coastal erosion —pose existential risks to small island states. Marine and terrestrial biodiversity are under pressure from unsustainable practices, habitat loss, and pollution, while waste management systems remain inadequate. Energy systems are overly dependent on fossil fuels, exposing economies to high cost s and volatility. Meanwhile, high youth unemployment and underdeveloped technical skills restrict economic opportunity and undermine resilience. Together, these challenges threaten sustainable development pathways and highlight the critical need for effective, integrated, and responsive programming. The Fuel Systems Section repairs, functionally checks and inspects aircraft fuel systems, fuel tanks, hydrazine systems, in-flight refueling receptacle systems, and related components. This section also performs maintenance on AME external fuel tanks, Conformal Fuel Tanks, and Weapons Bay Tanks and provides tempo rary storage for Conformal Fuel Tanks, and Weapons Bay Tanks. shall provide and install a complete Mobile Shelving System for the 48th Component Maintenance Squadron’s Fuel Systems Section at RAF Lakenheath. The desired outcome is a high -quality, centralized storage solution capable of housing all specialized tools, Alternate Mission Equipment (AME), and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) for both F-15 and F-35 maintenance operations. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice. L’adjudicataire s’engage à informer les personnes chargées de l’exécution du marché de l’existence de la politique de sécurité générale et des politiques spécifiques du PA, ainsi que de leur applicabilité dans le cadre de l’exécution du marché. 1.5. Matériel et données L’adjudicataire s’assure de mettre à disposition des personnes en charge de l’exécution du marché un matériel adapté et sécurisé, et à prendre au minimum les précautions suivantes (liste non-exhaustive) : Assurer une gestion des ressources informatiques (ordinateur, supports, etc.) d’un niveau d’entreprise en reprenant toutes les bonnes pratiques, de manière à prémunir toute compromission des ressources, pouvant conduire à une attaque directe ou indirecte sur le réseau ou les données de l’ETNIC et/ou de ses bénéficiaires. Mettre en place des mesures pour compartimenter les données relatives à l’ETNIC et/ou ses bénéficiaires. Protéger les ressources informatiques des personnes en charge de l’exécution du marché, par des mesures de chiffrement permettant d’éviter toute compromission en cas de perte ou de vol

Protéger les ressources informatiques des personnes en charge de l’exécution du marché, par des mesures de chiffrement permettant d’éviter toute compromission en cas de perte ou de vol. Protéger valablement les ordinateurs par des protections antivirales. Assurer une gestion de type « moindre privilège » sur le matériel des personnes en charge de l’exécution du marché. L’adjudicataire s’engage également à prendre d’initiative toutes précautions utiles afin de sécuriser de manière optimale les données et leur traitement contre la destruction, la perte, l’altération, la divulgation ou l’accès non-autorisé, de manière accidentelle ou illicite, et contre toute autre forme illicite de traitement. Le niveau de sécurité assuré par l’adjudicataire doit être adapté aux risques que présente le traitement, compte tenu des possibilités techniques existantes, des coûts de mise en œuvre et de la nature, de la portée, du contexte et des finalités du traitement. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. BACKGROUND The Department of the Air Force Art Collection is comprised of over 9,000 paintings, works on paper, mixed media, textiles, and sculptures spanning from World War I to the present day. To ensure the long-term preservation and security of a specific portion of this historic collection, the NMUSAF requires temporary, climate- controlled on-site storage for 992 designated artworks at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base (WPAFB). Due to inadequate historical storage conditions at their previous location, all 992 of these specific artworks have experienced prior mold damage. To mitigate risk and contain the issue, all assets will be securely wrapped and packaged in protective materials prior to being placed into the storage containers, preventing any further spread of mold. Maintaining strict, continuous environmental controls within the storage containers is critical to arrest any active mold growth and protect the collection from further deterioration. 2. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents.
